test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If one envelope requires a paper size of 18 cm × 12 cm, then how many envelopes can be made out of a sheet of paper of size 72 cm × 48 cm?
solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of paper for an envelope = 18 cm × 12 cm

Dimensions of paper available = 72 cm × 48 cm

**Calculations:**

Area of Paper available = 72 cm × 48 cm = 3456 cm²

Area of one envelope = 18 cm × 12 cm = 216 cm²

No. of envelopes = (3456)/(216) = 16

**Hence, The required no. of envelopes is 16.**
